culprit_citations.quoted_text: Bank of America, N.A. | U.S. Dollar 1,712 | Euro 1,692 | 10/04/24 | $ | ( 158 | )

findings.detail: The row's fair value currency was stored as U_EUR even though the source fair value cell is dollar-denominated; Euro belongs to the Currency Sold field.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 single-cell fair_value_currency issue. The raw source row for the foreign currency forward contract shows Currency Sold as Euro 1,692, but the Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation) amount is introduced by '$' and equals (158). Therefore the stored fair_value_currency of U_EUR is a real localized extraction/column-mapping error; the fair value is USD-denominated in source.
